:::{#def-bounded}
#### Bounded

A set $A \subseteq \reals$ is **bounded**
if it is both bounded above (@def-bounded-above) and bounded below (@def-bounded-below).
A [real-valued function](linear-algebra.qmd#def-real-vector-valued) is
bounded
if its [image](https://morrison-lab.github.io/mcs/functions.html#def-image) is.

:::
